description: This file serves as the main entry point for a React application. It imports necessary libraries and components, initializes the root DOM element, and renders the top-level App component within React's StrictMode for development checks.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root to enable rendering React components into the DOM.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the DOM container, starting with React.StrictMode and the App component.
